title: CNF representation of a local Boolean function
statement: Let $A$ be an inhabited type, let $m$ be a natural number, let $w$ assign an element of $A$ to each of the $m$ input positions, and let $f$ be a Boolean function of $m$ Boolean inputs. There is a CNF formula over variables in $A$ with cost at most $2^m(m+1)$ such that, for every Boolean assignment to $A$, the formula evaluates to $f$ applied to the assignment's values at the positions selected by $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ maps each of the $m$ positions to an element of $A$
$f$ is a Boolean function on $m$ Boolean inputs
